value.text:
Kanazawa Medical University (金沢医科大学, Kanazawa ika daigaku) is a private university in Uchinada, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1972, it opened on 1 June of that year. Its academic and clinical development has included medicine, nursing, graduate research and affiliated hospital services. Kanazawa Medical University Hospital is attached to the university, while the institution has also operated Kanazawa Medical University Himi Municipal Hospital in Himi, Toyama, since 2008.

The university’s affiliated nursing school opened in 1973. In 1974, the university hospital opened and a graduate research department was founded. Later developments included the establishment of the Institute of Comprehensive Medicine in 1989 and a high technology research center in 1998. Electronic health records were introduced in 2000. In 2003, a new hospital building opened alongside reorganizations of medical care and the Graduate School of Medicine. The medical school’s course system was restructured in 2004.

Nursing education underwent a further change in 2007, when the affiliated vocational nursing school was upgraded to a school of nursing offering four-year degree programs. In the following year, the university began operating the Himi Municipal Hospital as its designated administrator.
